title: recovery_objectives.v1
description: How much data a service may lose and how long it may be down (00_UniversalStandards/16_Service_Design_Record.md §3). rpo_seconds is the most recent window of acknowledged writes the service may lose; rto_seconds is the longest it may be unavailable. Replication does not meet an RPO on its own, because it copies a bad write or delete to every replica; the RPO is met by backups. Rules JSON Schema cannot express, enforced by the design record's relationship rules: every store whose data class requires backup declares a backup interval no longer than the RPO (an RPO of 0 needs continuous backup, interval 0); a region-scoped failover needs those stores placed in more than one region; and the RTO must fit inside every SLO's error budget.

scope.description: The largest failure the failover path survives.

procedure.description: Where the runbook is, or how failover happens automatically.
